Cc: security@novahealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: admin activity fields + export SLA

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week. As we work through the SIG questionnaire and the CAIQ cross-check, the GRC team needs a concise statement and sample export for admin activity (privileged ops / admin ACL changes / config changes). Specifically can you confirm the following: 

- Which event types are present in the admin activity ledger (e.g., user.create, user.delete, role.assign, token.create, key.rotate, model.deploy, config.change, console.login)?
- What fields are included for each event (timestamp, actor_id, actor_email, actor_ip, action, resource_type, resource_id, before/after payloads, request_id)?
- Retention policy for admin events (default retention, retention by customer tier, snapshot/archive options)?
- On-demand export options: CSV vs. JSONL, support for indexed full-text search vs. raw bundles, and estimated time-to-deliver for a 90‑day slice (approx 150k events).
- Redaction options and recommended PII scrubbing approach for customer-facing exports.

We also need an example export manifest describing file checksums and whether you support HMAC-attested delivery. Can you get us an initial response and a sample export (sanitized) within 48 hours?

Best,
Marta
Marta Lewis
Information Security Manager, NovaHealth

---
Attachments: admin_activity_query_20260407.csv (1KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lewis <marta.lewis@novahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: admin activity fields + export SLA

Marta — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below and I attached a short guidance PDF plus a sanitized sample manifest. We can produce the full 90-day slice as a JSONL bundle with an indexed search tarball if you prefer.

1) Event types logged: user.create, user.update, user.delete, role.assign, role.revoke, token.create, token.revoke, key.rotate, model.deploy, model.rollback, config.change, console.login, console.logout, api.auth_failure, api.rate_limit. (We also capture operator-initiated session recordings as metadata for Dedicated/private customers when enabled.)

2) Fields per event (standardized schema): event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_internal_id, actor_email, actor_ip (v4/v6), action, resource_type, resource_id, resource_path, client_app, request_id, correlation_id, before_change (nullable JSON), after_change (nullable JSON), region, env_tag.

3) Retention: default hosted retention = 180 days for admin activity. Dedicated customers may configure 3/6/12/36 month retention. Private deployments are customer-managed. We support on-demand archival to S3 with object lifecycle policies.

4) Export options & SLA:
   - Formats: JSONL (structured), CSV (flattened), Parquet (columnar)
   - Indexing: we can produce an ELK-style indexed bundle (compressed tar with _index and shards) for full-text and request_id search; otherwise raw bundles are provided.
   - Delivery: standard on-demand export for a 90-day slice (150k events) — estimated generation time 3–5 hours; with indexing + HMAC signing add 1–2 hours. For SLA-backed Dedicated customers we can prioritize and deliver within 2 business hours.

5) Redaction: we offer field-level redaction rules in the export pipeline. Recommended approach: redact actor_ip and replace with ip_hash (HMAC-sha256 with customer-provided salt) when customers require pseudonymization, and redact any PII in before/after blobs using regex-driven scrubbing rules. We can provide a sanitized sample export (attached).

We support HMAC-attested delivery (manifest includes file checksums and an HMAC over the manifest). Attached is export_guidance_v1.pdf and the signed manifest.

Next steps: I’ve looped in Kimberly to schedule the export job and Vanessa for compliance attestation/manifest signing. If you want the indexed search bundle, please confirm so we can allocate the index worker.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachments: export_guidance_v1.pdf, export_manifest_signed.sha256)
